text:
Subject: Your order has shipped

Hi Anna,

Good news, your order #40-2291 is on its way. Items: wireless headphones (1). Estimated delivery: Wednesday. You can track the package from the Orders page in your account.

Thanks for shopping with us.

Subject: A new sign-in to your account

We noticed a new sign-in to your account from Chrome on Windows in Bratislava, Slovakia. If this was you, you don't need to do anything. If you don't recognise this activity, open the app and review your recent activity under Settings > Security.

Subject: Your password was changed

The password for your account was changed on 14 March at 09:12. If you made this change, no further action is needed. If you didn't, contact support from the Help page on our website.

Subject: Reset your password

Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password for your account. The link expires in 30 minutes. If you didn't ask for this, you can safely ignore this email and your password won't change.

Subject: Your monthly statement is ready

Your statement for February is now available. Sign in to online banking or the mobile app to view it. We will never ask for your PIN or password by email.

Subject: Receipt for your payment

Thank you for your payment of 12.99 EUR for your monthly subscription. Plan: Premium Individual. Next billing date: 3 November. You can manage or cancel your subscription in account settings.

Subject: Your invoice from the hosting provider

Hello, your invoice INV-20931 for 4.50 EUR has been paid automatically with the card ending 4421. No action is required. A PDF copy is available in the billing section of the dashboard.

Subject: [GitHub] A new SSH key was added to your account

A new public key was added to your account. If you added this key, you can ignore this message. If you believe this key was added in error, remove it from your SSH and GPG keys settings.

Subject: Your pull request was merged

The pull request 'Fix login form validation' was merged into main by the maintainer. 3 checks passed. You can view the commit history on the repository page.

Subject: Your flight booking confirmation

Thank you for booking with us. Booking reference: QX7P2L. Vienna to London, 12 December, departing 07:40. Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Have a pleasant trip.

Subject: Reminder: dentist appointment tomorrow

This is a reminder of your appointment tomorrow at 14:30. If you need to reschedule, please call the clinic during opening hours. See you soon.

Subject: Interview invitation - Junior QA Engineer

Hi Peter,

Thank you for applying. We'd like to invite you to a 45-minute video interview with our QA lead next week. Please reply with two or three time slots that work for you.

Best regards,
HR team

Subject: Re: sprint planning

Hi all, I moved the sprint planning to Thursday 10:00 because of the release. Please update your tickets in Jira before the meeting and add estimates for the regression tests. Thanks, Lucia

Subject: Notes from today's standup

Quick summary: the payment bug is fixed on staging, Marek is finishing the API tests, and we still need someone to review the accessibility changes. Let me know if I missed anything.

Subject: Lunch on Friday?

Hey, a few of us are going to the new ramen place on Friday around 12:30. Want to join? No worries if you're busy.

Subject: Weekly newsletter: testing tips

This week: how to write readable end-to-end tests, a comparison of Playwright and Cypress, and five common mistakes in test data management. You are receiving this because you subscribed on our website. Unsubscribe at any time.

Subject: Your package will arrive today

Your parcel from the online store is out for delivery and should arrive between 13:00 and 15:00. The courier will ring the bell. You can change delivery preferences in the courier app.

Subject: Two-factor authentication enabled

Two-factor authentication is now turned on for your account. From now on you'll be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in on a new device.

Subject: Thanks for your feedback

Thanks for taking the time to rate your recent support conversation. We read every response and use it to improve our service.

Subject: Your library books are due soon

The following item is due on 28 October: 'Clean Code'. You can renew it once online through your library account or at the front desk.

Subject: Team offsite agenda

Hi team, attached is the agenda for next week's offsite. We start at 9:00 with a retrospective, then workshops in the afternoon. Dinner is booked for 19:00. Let me know about any dietary requirements.

Subject: Your course certificate

Congratulations on completing the course 'Introduction to Software Testing'. Your certificate is now available on your profile and can be added to LinkedIn.

Subject: Your tax return was received

We confirm that your electronic tax return for last year was received on 31 March. You will be informed by post about the result. Please do not reply to this automated message.
Hi mum, landed safely, I'll call you tonight when I'm at the hotel. Love you
Your verification code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code with anyone, including our staff.
Hey, are we still on for football tonight at 7? I can pick you up on the way.

Subject: Your rental agreement

Hello, please find the rental agreement for the flat attached as discussed during the viewing. Let me know if you have any questions before signing. Kind regards, Jana

Subject: Event tickets

Your 2 tickets for the concert on Saturday are in the app. Doors open at 19:00. Show the QR code at the entrance. Enjoy the show!

Subject: Code review requested

Ondrej requested your review on 'Add retry logic to the upload service'. 4 files changed. Review the changes in the repository when you have time.

Subject: Welcome to the team!

Hi Eva, welcome aboard! Your laptop will be ready on Monday morning at the IT desk on the 2nd floor. Your onboarding buddy is Tomas, he'll show you around. See you soon!

Subject: Action required: your account has been suspended

Dear valued customer, we have detected unusual activity on your account and it has been temporarily suspended. To restore access you must verify your identity within 24 hours. Click here to verify now. Failure to do so will result in permanent closure.

Subject: Payment declined - update your billing information

We were unable to process your last payment for your subscription. Your membership will be cancelled today unless you update your payment details. Please log in using the secure link below and re-enter your card information.

Hi, are you available? I need a quick favour. I'm in a meeting and can't talk. Please purchase 5 Apple gift cards of 100 EUR each for a client, it's urgent and confidential. Scratch the back and send me photos of the codes as soon as possible. Thanks, the CEO

Subject: Urgent wire transfer

Hi, I need you to process an urgent wire transfer today for a confidential acquisition. Please don't discuss this with anyone else in the office. I will send the bank details shortly. Reply to confirm you can handle it right now. Sent from my iPhone

Subject: Change of bank details

Dear accounts team, please be advised that our company has changed banks due to an audit. Kindly update our records and send all outstanding invoice payments to the new account below with immediate effect. Do not use the old account.

Subject: Invoice overdue - final notice

Please find attached the overdue invoice. Payment must be received within 48 hours to avoid legal action and additional fees. Open the attached document and enable editing to view the invoice.

Subject: Your mailbox is almost full

Your email storage quota has exceeded its limit. You will not be able to send or receive new messages. Click below to upgrade your mailbox quota for free and keep your messages. IT Help Desk

Subject: Microsoft 365: password expires today

The password for your Office 365 account expires today. To keep using your current password, confirm your login details using the link below. If you do not act, your account will be locked.

Subject: You have a new voicemail

You received a voice message (00:43) from an unknown caller. Sign in with your work email and password to listen to the message in the secure portal.

Subject: Shared document: Q4 bonus and salary review

A document has been shared with you: 'Q4 bonus and salary adjustments.pdf'. Sign in with your company email account to view the file. This link will expire in 24 hours.
DHL: Your parcel could not be delivered because of an unpaid customs fee of 1.99 EUR. Pay within 24h or the package will be returned to the sender: dhl-redelivery-fee.com
Your package is on hold at our warehouse. Please confirm your address and pay the redelivery fee here to schedule a new delivery date.
Bank alert: a payment of 849.00 EUR to an unknown merchant is pending. If this was not you, cancel it immediately by verifying your card details here.
Hi mum, this is my new number, my phone broke. Can you send me money for the rent today? I'll pay you back tomorrow, it's urgent. Please don't call, I can only text right now.

Subject: Tax refund notification

After the last annual calculation of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 312.40 EUR. Please submit the tax refund request and allow us 3-5 business days to process it. Fill in the form with your card details to receive the refund.

Subject: Congratulations, you've won!

Your email address was selected in our annual online lottery. You have won an iPhone 17 Pro. To claim your prize, pay the small shipping fee and confirm your personal details within 48 hours.

Subject: Security alert: someone has your password

Google stopped someone from signing in to your account. Someone just used your password to try to sign in. Please review your activity immediately by logging in through the link below and change your password.

Subject: Your Apple ID has been locked

Your Apple ID was locked for security reasons after several failed login attempts. To unlock it, verify your account information. If you do not verify within 12 hours your account will be permanently disabled.

Subject: Netflix: we're having trouble with your billing information

We're having some trouble with your current billing information. We'll try again, but in the meantime you may want to update your payment details. Restart membership by updating your card.

Subject: Crypto wallet verification required

Due to new regulations, all wallet holders must verify their wallet. Unverified wallets will be frozen. Enter your recovery phrase on the verification page to complete the process.

Subject: Approve sign-in request

We detected a sign-in attempt that requires your approval. Approve the request in the next 10 minutes or your account will be locked. If you keep getting these prompts, reply with the code you received to stop them.

Subject: HR: updated employee handbook - signature required

All employees must review and sign the updated employee handbook by end of day. Log in with your corporate credentials using the link below to access and sign the document.

Subject: Your domain is about to expire

Your domain name will expire today and your website and email will stop working. Renew now to avoid losing your domain forever. Pay the renewal fee using the secure payment form.

Subject: Job offer - work from home, 500 EUR per day

We found your CV online and would like to offer you a remote position. No experience needed, only 1-2 hours per day. To start, send us a copy of your ID and your bank account number so we can register your salary payments.

Subject: Your account will be closed

Dear user, your account has been flagged for violating our terms of service. If you believe this is a mistake, you must appeal within 24 hours by confirming your identity at the link below, otherwise your page will be permanently deleted.

Subject: Unusual sign-in activity

We detected something unusual about a recent sign-in. To help keep you safe, we've blocked access to your inbox, contacts list and calendar. Please verify your account now to regain access. Thanks, The Account Team

Subject: Refund pending

We owe you a refund of 59.99 EUR for an overcharged order. To receive your money, please log in and confirm your bank details. This offer expires in 24 hours.
Your Revolut account has been restricted. To avoid suspension, verify your identity now at revolut-secure-verify.com

Subject: RE: outstanding payment

Hello, hope you are well. As discussed, please find the updated remittance details attached. Kindly process the payment today as the supplier is threatening to stop deliveries. Let me know once done. Regards, Finance Director

Subject: Final warning: police case against you

A case has been registered against your name for unpaid fines. To avoid arrest, pay the fine immediately using the payment link and reply with the transaction number. Do not ignore this message.

Are you at your desk? I need you to run a quick errand for me. Buy six Steam or Amazon gift cards, 200 each, for a client presentation. Keep it between us for now, it's a surprise. Send me the redemption codes by email when you have them.

Subject: Quick task

Hi, I'm boarding a flight and can't take calls. I need a favour done before noon: pick up some prepaid cards for our partners and send me pictures of the numbers on the back. I'll pay you back when I'm back in the office. Thanks

Subject: Confidential request

Good morning, do you have a moment? I have a sensitive task for you that requires discretion. Please reply with your mobile number so I can text you the details. Regards, Managing Director

Hi, it's your manager. I'm stuck in back-to-back meetings. Can you buy gift cards for the team as a reward? Get 4 cards, 250 EUR each, and send me the card numbers and PINs. Don't mention it to the others, I want it to be a surprise.

Subject: Payroll update

Hi, I changed banks recently and need my salary paid into my new account from this month. Can you update my direct deposit details before the next payroll run? I'll send the new account number once you confirm.
